field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Off: no canonical link is emitted by this module. Magento's own canonical settings under Catalog > Search Engine Optimization are unaffected either way — leave both on and the page gets two canonicals, which is worse than none, so pick one.

field.label: Query parameters kept in the canonical
field.comment: Comma separated. Everything not listed is dropped. `p` (the pager) is listed by default because page 2 of a category really is a different document; a layered-navigation filter is not. `___store`, `___from_store`, `uenc` and `SID` are dropped whatever is typed here.

field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Emitted on product, category, CMS page and home pages only — the four page types where "the same document in another language" is a question with an answer. Groups of fewer than two distinct locales are suppressed.

field.label: Primary store code for x-default
field.comment: Store view code, e.g. `default`. Where this page exists in that store, it gets x-default. Where it does not, the fallback is a store sharing the primary's language, then the first alternate. Left blank, the first alternate always wins. Default scope only: an hreflang group spans the whole installation, so its primary cannot be a per-website answer.

field.label: Publish a robots.txt file
field.comment: Off by default, and switching it off deletes the published file rather than emptying it. Website scope only: robots.txt is addressed by host.

field.label: Content
field.comment: Validated on save: every line has to be a "Directive: value" pair, group directives have to follow a User-agent line, and a Sitemap has to be an absolute URL. Saved content is written to pub/media/scr1be/robots/<website_code>.txt; see the module README for the one webserver rule that makes /robots.txt serve it.
